T1:
This image is a chart from a technical document (text may be in Russian). Read its axes.
Return only a JSON object, no other text:
{"x_axis": {"title": <string or null>, "unit": <string or null>, "tick_labels": [<string>, ...]},
 "y_axis": {"title": <string or null>, "unit": <string or null>, "tick_labels": [<string>, ...]},
 "legend": [<string>, ...]}
Rules: copy every printed tick label of each axis exactly as printed (keep minus signs, decimal commas and dates as they are), x from left to right, y from bottom to top; for a categorical axis give the category labels; "unit" is the unit of measure printed in or next to the axis title; "legend" lists the series names printed in a legend or as labels on the curves (empty list if none); use null where nothing is printed; do not invent labels.
T2:
This image is a chart from a technical document (text may be in Russian). Extract the data of every data series drawn in the plot (lines, curves, marker sets).
Return only a JSON object, no other text:
{"x_axis": {"title": <string or null>, "unit": <string or null>, "type": "numeric" | "date" | "category"},
 "y_axis": {"title": <string or null>, "unit": <string or null>},
 "series": [{"label": <legend or curve label, or null>, "color": <colour name or hex>, "points": [[x, y], ...]}, ...]}
Rules: read the values with the axis scales; give a point at every data marker and at every vertex where the line changes direction, and for smooth curves without markers at least one point per interval between x tick labels, from the first to the last visible point; x as a number, or "dd.mm.yyyy" for a date axis, or the category label for a category axis; y as a number in the axis units; include every drawn series, also those without a legend entry; do not add series that are not drawn.
H:
This image is a chart. For every tick label printed along the x axis and along the y axis, give its exact text and its bounding box.
Return only a JSON array, no other text: [{"axis": "x" | "y", "text": <string>, "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}, ...]

notes.T1: tick labels, axis titles and units, legend - compared with Tesseract as agent FD runs it in route R
notes.T2: chart to data - compared with the truth and with route R geometry on the same image
notes.H: grounded tick labels (Qwen only): text + box feed route R calibration instead of Tesseract (hybrid arm H)
